record.question: The Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP) has been renamed as the:
options: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade.
Department for Promotion of Trade and Industry
record.explanation: Answer A: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade.. The Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP) was renamed the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT). Reference: https://dpiit.gov.in/about-us. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
